```

168c92b Fix frame interpolator sizing; soften and bound the HDR highlight lift
b60ea53 Revert MetalFX to perceptual colour processing (linear needs 16-bit intermediates)
cf1a1ce HDR: drop the blocking encode wait, reset overlay geometry on teardown
ea7e8db Fix HDR frame interpolation and SDR gradient banding
b0068b3 docs: record in-game shader pack matrix (photon sampler limit, Solas GL4.4 clear)
ccf4b68 Keep Minecraft UI out of the HDR boost
0ed5df8 Ladder rung 2: GLSL -> SPIR-V -> MSL prototype
7b9544e Add WARM, COOL and NATURAL display palettes
97bf94c Add display palettes (VIBRANT keeps Minecraft colours in HDR) and pack inspection
f70f8a5 Enable HDR output under Iris; fix bloom ghost, overlay geometry and scaler-switch freeze
2629538 Fix native bridge crashes; run the Metal pipeline under Iris shader packs
```

Nightlies are untested snapshots. Use a tagged release for normal play.
Requires Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Java 25+ and a HotSpot JDK (Temurin) on macOS.
